title: Notice of 2026 Annual Investor Update
gist: Glencore plc announced it will hold its annual investor update on 7 December 2026 at 11.00am UK, with slides published at 10.30am and a live audio webcast plus 24-hour replay. The notice restates Glencore's profile as a producer and marketer of 60+ commodities with 140,000+ staff in 30+ countries, serving automotive, steel, power, battery and oil customers.

insights.claim: Glencore plc will host its annual investor update presentation on Monday 7 December 2026 at 11.00am UK time, with slides posted for download at 10.30am UK.
insights.speaker: Glencore investor reports
insights.so_what: Scheduled catalyst: watch for revised guidance, capital allocation or strategy changes on 7 Dec 2026.
insights.quote: Glencore plc will host an annual investor update presentation on Monday, 7 December 2026 at 11.00 am UK.

insights.claim: Glencore's 7 December 2026 investor update will be delivered via a live audio webcast with an on-demand replay available within 24 hours and archived on the company website.
insights.speaker: Glencore investor reports
insights.so_what: Content will be publicly accessible for post-event analysis even if the live session is missed.
insights.quote: an on-demand replay will be available within 24 hours of the presentation ending at the same link as the live webcast

insights.claim: Glencore describes itself as one of the world's largest diversified natural resource companies, producing and marketing more than 60 commodities, with over 140,000 employees and contractors across more than 30 countries.
insights.speaker: Glencore investor reports
insights.so_what: Scale and breadth make Glencore's commentary a broad read-through on global commodity demand.
insights.quote: a major producer and marketer of more than 60 commodities

insights.claim: Glencore's customers are principally industrial consumers in the automotive, steel, power generation, battery manufacturing and oil sectors, and the company also provides financing, logistics and other services to commodity producers and consumers.
insights.speaker: Glencore investor reports
insights.so_what: Glencore's outlook doubles as a demand signal for autos, steel, power, batteries and oil.
insights.quote: Glencore’s customers are principally industrial consumers, such as those in the automotive, steel, power generation, battery manufacturing and oil sectors.
insights.locator: Glencore’s customers are principally industrial consumers
